turns.text: Hi, my flight to Paris has been delayed and honestly I'm pretty fed up. I need a hotel and I want to be put on something else.
I'm sorry about the delay, I'll help. First I need to verify you, can I have your booking code and last name?
Thank you, Mr. Moreau. I see SK312 to Paris, delayed from 19:15 to 20:45 because of an operations issue on our side. Is that the flight?
Yes, that one. Ninety minutes, that's ridiculous. So I get a hotel, right?
I understand the frustration. A hotel voucher is only available when an airline-caused delay runs overnight, and this one departs at 20:45 the same evening, so I can't issue one.
Okay. Then what about moving me to another flight? Something earlier.
Since we caused the delay, rebooking is free with no fare difference. The only other Paris flight today was SK310 at 09:00 and it has already left, so SK312 at 20:45 is the next available one.
So I'm just stuck waiting until almost nine tonight.
I'm afraid so for today, yes. If you'd like, I can arrange a supervisor callback to discuss it further.
No, forget the callback. Fine, I'll keep the booking as it is.
Understood, I've left you on SK312 at 20:45 with no changes. To sum up, no hotel voucher applies to a same-day delay, and your booking is unchanged.
